title: International Mosquito Air and Ground Crew Memorial
memorial_details: description: The memorial consists of two main parts.  The lower part is a plaque with the inscription, set on a small brick wall with brick pillars either side that reach the same height as the plaque, there are damaged sections of a Rolls Royce merlin engine either side of the paving.  Above this there is a wall mounted replica Mosquito propeller with a small plaque beneath detailing its donation. This propeller replaces the previous aircrash damaged and twisted one which was stolen in 2005.
